title: Przegląd Bibliograficzny Hutnictwa, October 1951
version: Hutnik, vol. 18, no. 10, October 1951, bibliographic abstract 7–81
lineage: An original 1951 specialist bibliography summarizing Hellbrügge’s 1950 paper; not the original 1950 article and not evidence the apparatus entered industrial operation.

passages.note: Contemporaneous Polish technical abstract describes the small experimental Gerlafingen converter and identifies the original German article, Stahl und Eisen 70, no. 26, December 1950.
